claims.claim: Satya Nadella announced Microsoft's largest Copilot update on 25 September 2026 and positioned Copilot as a new OS for work.
claims.episode_span: Satya Nadella announced the largest Microsoft Copilot update to date on 25 September 2026 and called Copilot "a new OS for work"
claims.source_title: Microsoft unveils its biggest Copilot update: Home, Code and Autopilot
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced the company's largest update to Microsoft Copilot to date, positioning Copilot as "a new OS for work" that spans every model, every form factor and every task.

claims.claim: The update's four pillars are Autopilot, Code, Home and Office, with Copilot also invocable in Teams and a Today view across Microsoft 365.
claims.episode_span: Autopilot is a proactive, long-running agent for the enterprise.
claims.source_title: Microsoft unveils its biggest Copilot update: Home, Code and Autopilot
claims.supporting_quote: The update combines four pillars: Autopilot, a proactive and long-running agent for the enterprise; Code, which lets users build apps with Copilot hosted inside their company's tenant (built on the same underlying technology as GitHub Copilot); Home, which merges the Chat and Cowork experiences into one starting point; and Office, with Word, Excel and PowerPoint now fully embedded in Copilot.

claims.claim: Home and Code roll out through Frontier in the coming weeks, Autopilot expands to private preview at the end of September, and Today enters private preview in October.
claims.episode_span: Autopilot expands to private preview at the end of September, and Today enters private preview in October
claims.source_title: Microsoft unveils its biggest Copilot update: Home, Code and Autopilot
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft says Home and Code begin rolling out through its Frontier programme in the coming weeks, Autopilot expands to private preview at the end of September, and Today enters private preview in October, later coming to Outlook and Teams.

claims.claim: OpenAI and other defendants asked a court to strike two expert declarations and disregard other evidence Apple recently submitted in a trade-secret case.
claims.episode_span: They ask the court to strike two expert declarations and to disregard other evidence Apple recently submitted.
claims.source_title: OpenAI accuses Apple of improperly adding new evidence to trade secrets case
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI and the other defendants in Apple’s trade secret misappropriation lawsuit made a new filing, asking the court to strike two expert declarations and disregard other evidence Apple recently submitted.

claims.claim: A wave of Google DeepMind researchers has exited to launch AI startups focused on alternatives to LLMs.
claims.episode_span: The departures are to launch their own AI startups focused on alternatives to large language models.
claims.source_title: Wave of Google DeepMind researchers exit to launch AI startups focused on non-LLM alternatives
claims.supporting_quote: A look at the wave of Google DeepMind researchers who have exited recently to launch their own AI startups focused on alternatives to LLMs (Bloomberg)

claims.claim: Koray Kavukcuoglu said Gemini 4 should launch much earlier than the end of the year and that Google wants an early version as soon as possible.
claims.episode_span: the model should launch "much earlier" than the end of the year
claims.supporting_quote: should launch “much earlier” than the end of the year, Koray Kavukcuoglu, the head of Google DeepMind, said

claims.claim: Gemini 3.5 Pro never shipped, reportedly because coding performance fell short, and Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash in August and Gemini 3.8 Flash in early September.
claims.episode_span: Gemini 3.5 Pro, originally announced for I/O in May, never shipped, reportedly because its coding performance fell short.
claims.source_title: Gemini 4: Leaks, Release Date and Why Google Must Catch Up
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini 3.5 Pro, originally announced for Google’s I/O developer conference in May, never shipped, reportedly because its coding performance fell short.

claims.claim: TestingCatalog reports Argon checkpoints of Gemini 4 Pro tested since mid-September can generate up to 256,000 tokens, four times the previous limit, and took 2.4 to 20 minutes in the highest reasoning mode.
claims.episode_span: those leaks say a response can run to 256,000 tokens, four times the previous limit
claims.source_title: Gemini 4: Leaks, Release Date and Why Google Must Catch Up
claims.supporting_quote: Argon can reportedly generate up to 256,000 tokens in a single response, four times the previous limit.

claims.claim: Windows Latest reports Microsoft is stripping Copilot from Windows 11 while Nadella says they are building Copilot as a new OS.
claims.source_title: "We're building Copilot as a new OS," says Satya Nadella, even as Microsoft strips it from Windows 11
claims.supporting_quote: "We're building Copilot as a new OS," says Satya Nadella, even as Microsoft strips it from Windows 11

claims.claim: Tesla officially launched high-volume Semi production Thursday in Sparks, Nevada, at an invite-only livestreamed factory event Musk skipped for a White House dinner with Xi Jinping.
claims.episode_span: Tesla's team was in Sparks, Nevada, for a livestreamed, invite-only factory event that officially launched high-volume production of the Semi.
claims.source_title: Tesla’s big electric truck faces an even bigger infrastructure challenge
claims.supporting_quote: But his Tesla team was in Sparks, Nevada, on Thursday to focus on, well, an electric vehicle: the long-awaited Tesla Semi.

claims.claim: Musk has targeted a $20 trillion valuation, nearly four times Nvidia, which Ars calls the market leader, while charging gaps still limit electric trucking for the 500-mile Semi.
claims.episode_span: he has targeted a $20 trillion valuation, nearly four times the value Ars assigns to Nvidia as market leader.
claims.source_title: Tesla’s big electric truck faces an even bigger infrastructure challenge
claims.supporting_quote: He’s targeted a $20 trillion valuation—nearly four times the value of market leader Nvidia —on that premise.
